Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts on Thursday again voted to close the facility for two years of maintenance, according to a person familiar with the decision, proceeding with the controversial plan following a court rebuke that foiled an initial attempt to shutter the institution.

title: Trump Pivots to Economic Squeeze of ‘Entrenched’ Iran Regime
title_cn: 特朗普转向对“根深蒂固”的伊朗政权进行经济挤压
summary: The US military campaign against Iran has so far failed to force the regime to capitulate. The Trump administration is betting once again that suffocating economic pressure will do the job.

title: USS Lincoln to Come Home From Middle East: WSJ
title_cn: 林肯号航空母舰将从中东回国：《华尔街日报》
summary: The US is sending a new aircraft carrier to replace the USS Lincoln in the Middle East according to the Wall Street Journal. The ship has been deployed for 250 days. Also there are new worries about the size of America's weapons stockpile as talks to end the war with Iran seem to be at a standstill. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports on it all from the White House on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Colombia Earthquake: Destroyed Towns Face Costly Challenge of Rebuilding
title_cn: 哥伦比亚地震：被毁城镇面临代价高昂的重建挑战
summary: In the lush mountains and coffee farms of El Cairo in Colombia’s western Andes, there’s barely a home unscathed by Monday’s earthquake.

title: Trump Explains Why He Secretly Switched Planes in Turkey
title_cn: 特朗普解释为何他在土耳其秘密转机
summary: President Donald Trump explains why he secretly got off Air Force One in Turkey and then took off on another plane to England. The switch took place on July 8 in Ankara where Trump attended a NATO summit. On Aug. 11, Trump told reporters that the Secret Service and military made the decision for him to switch planes in response to unspecified safety threats. The elaborate maneuver, first reported by the Washington Post, was prompted by an Iranian assassination threat against Trump. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Attacks on Yemen Killed 153 Civilians in 2025, Pentagon Says
title_cn: 五角大楼称，2025 年美国对也门的袭击造成 153 名平民死亡
summary: US airstrikes on Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen last year killed 153 civilians and injured 243 others, according to a Defense Department review of the attacks.

title: Gas Prices Won't Drop Much Lower By Election Day, Says Rebecca Babin
title_cn: 丽贝卡·巴宾 (Rebecca Babin) 表示，到选举日为止，汽油价格不会大幅下跌
summary: Rebecca Babin, CIBC Private Wealth senior energy trader, said that she doesn't expect gas prices to drop much lower before election day and that the price at the pump will likely be lower than the White House would like it to be for November's midterms. Babin said that while oil prices have climbed as tensions have build back up in the Strait of Hormuz, it is China's position in the oil market that is keeping prices from growing to $100 a barrel.  (Source: Bloomberg)
